Use case: ui-mockup. Create high-fidelity complete application screenshot, native requested size 1440x960, front-facing flat code-buildable UI. Product: PSF Request Portal / Setup File Management, internal NXP engineering/manufacturing request workflow. Direction C modern industrial engineering operations, calm, precise, daily-use data density. NOT marketing or generic dashboard. Strong visual coherence across screens. Strict tokens: pure white main surface #FFFFFF; pale neutral sidebar #F4F6F8; canvas #F7F9FB only outside main regions; dark text #172B3A; secondary text #536676; thin crisp borders #D9E1E7; cyan primary #007E9E, hover #00677F, selection #E8F5F8; tiny lime #A8C83A brand moment only, never universal success; semantic success #18724B, warning #916008, error #B42332; icon and text distinguish status, no rainbow pills. Inter-like neutral sans: main title 24px semibold, section 16px semibold, body/inputs 14px, labels 12px, codes 12px monospace, table rows 52px, controls 36px, radius 4px, almost no shadow. 216px left sidebar, 52px thin white top header, 24px page gutters, full available width, restrained open sections separated with rules. Sidebar plain text brand 'PSF Request Portal' then 'Setup File Management', no NXP logo recreation. Tiny 3px cyan/lime bar may sit beside wordmark. Nav groups Work: Dashboard, All PSF Requests, My drafts, Create Request, Export to Excel, Audit History. Administration: Users & Roles, Form Management, Status Management, Auto-fill Rules. Only restrained 16px thin Lucide-like outline icons that clarify. Selected nav pale cyan with 2px dark cyan left indicator, no giant saturated backgrounds. Account menu top right 'Audit Admin' with small square initials, theme icon retained. Breadcrumbs top left. Primary New Request button cyan where applicable. No gradient, glossy panels, huge whitespace, giant round cards, decorative art/widgets or fake charts. All labels and controls intended for native HTML/React, never raster UI implementation. Sample records clearly plausible examples, no claims about actual company data. Custom statuses are configurable and not sequential; do not add a progress percentage bar or fixed stepper. Every visible status uses compact icon plus readable text without a pill border. Product Type plain muted secondary text. Screenshot contains entire working primary viewport with bottom continuation where appropriate. Excellent typography and alignment.
SCREEN: Dashboard selected. Heading 'Dashboard', one-line description 'Related requests and current work'. Directly below heading, compact single 48px summary strip with three clickable text segments 'Open work 6' (selected cyan underline), 'Overdue 1', 'Completed 1'; not cards. Toolbar in one aligned row labeled 'Keyword' with wide search input, 'Status' select 'All statuses', 'Reset'. Main table filling width below, crisp light header, 8 visible rows, columns 'Request', 'Status', 'Priority', 'Due date', 'Owner / department'. Request cell two stacked lines: monospace number small muted then strong title with product type subtle below if space. Rows sample: PSF-2026-1042 / S32K3 wafer sort setup / New Product / Submitted / Normal / 09 Oct 2026 / Unassigned; PSF-2026-1041 / LPC55 transfer qualification / Transfer Product / In Progress / Normal / 09 Oct 2026 / Chai Prasert / GNTC; PSF-2026-1040 / i.MX 9 probe validation / New Product / Need More Information / Urgent / 01 Oct 2026 / Chai Prasert / GNTC; PSF-2026-1039 / MCX production release / Transfer Product / PSF Created / High / 09 Oct 2026 / Unassigned; PSF-2026-1038 / S32G reference setup update / New Product / Completed / Normal / 09 Oct 2026 / Chai Prasert / GNTC; 3 similar readable rows named NTAG wafer map revision, Kinetis transfer request, S32R high priority setup. Compact result footer '8 requests', not fake pagination when no more pages. Open table layout, minimal framing, excellent scanability.
